steps.text: Inspect the empty display case at the Grand Museum in Civitas illa Fortis to start the quest.
Speak to Curator Herminius in the centre of the Grand Museum.
choices: Could you tell me more about that empty display?

steps.text: Investigate the tools behind the empty display case.
Inspect the empty display case again.
Talk to any citizen in the room.
Talk to any academic in the room.
Talk to any tourist in the room.
Speak to Regulus Cento south of the Grand Museum.
choices: Have you seen anybody suspicious around?

steps.text: Head east to the docks and speak to any Trader Crewmember.
choices: Have you seen a man with a case?
As long as it is just the one favour...

steps.text: Head south of the Fortis Cothon to Artima's crafting store and speak to her.
choices: I was hoping for some help.

steps.text: Return up north and speak to any Trader Crewmember.
choices: So, about that man with the case.

steps.text: Head to Port Sarim and speak to Trader Stan or any Trader Crewmember on the southern deck. To get to Port Sarim quickly, you can charter a ship.
choices: Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?

steps.text: Head to the Rune Shop in north western Port Sarim and speak to Betty.
choices: Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?

steps.text: Read Betty's notes.
Right-click pickpocket Curator Haig Halen.
Head to Varrock Museum and speak to Curator Haig Halen.
Open the door to the room in the north east and search the crate.
Go speak to Curator Haig Halen again.
Shame Curator Haig Halen, get the meter to 100%.
Speak to Curator before a cutscene.
Watch cutscene.
Speak to the Curator in the centre of the Grand Museum to complete the quest.
